svg.title: Acoustic end-to-end pipeline v2 master topology
svg.desc: Four dataset-native lanes feed dataset-specific parsers and encoder-specific preprocessing, one selected candidate encoder, optional eligible adapters or fusion, and dataset-native heads. Training control and evidence are separated.
svg.text: Four dataset-native lanes → one selected candidate path → eligible native heads | complete system contract, not four-dataset training evidence

text.tspan: paper tasks: I, E, CAS, DAS one-vs-rest
no official split · group by P-number
fixed-grid source benchmark; no local reproduction
does not validate generic token interface
opens legal head; never reads target at inference
patient diagnosis is separate secondary branch

svg.text: TRAINING / EVALUATION CONTROL PLANE — lateral controls, not sequential audio modules

text.tspan: only eligible native losses and metric rows
inference uses declared capability, not target labels
W16 SG-SCL · W18 PAFA · W26 ADD-RSC
one preregistered intervention point at a time
per dataset · per unit · per class · worst dataset

svg.text: OPERATIONAL / EVIDENCE INSET — separate from the four-lane target system

text.tspan: ICBHI cycles + SPRSound events → mono/16 kHz → fixed 8 s repeat/truncate
protocol/smoke/profile prove finite routing, loss, gradients and profiling—not performance
HF and KAUH are not active in R0

svg.text: R0–R3 ARE RECIPES, NOT THE FOUR DATASETS

text.tspan: R2 MVST · identity/smoke; paper protocol caveat
R3 PAFA · smoke/profile; test-selected checkpoint caveat
No one-to-one R0↔ICBHI, R1↔SPR, R2↔HF, R3↔KAUH mapping
shared-compatible head: 0 material improvements · negative within frozen-feature scope
support-aware cRT: 2 gains, but global regression guardrail failed · HOLD/negative
shortcut diagnostic: 0/2 votes · not supported/inconclusive; dataset-ID access is not causal proof
event-sensitive pooling: 0 material votes · not supported/inconclusive
four-dataset attribution/D2: target-supervised single-seed frozen features · no full-encoder conclusion

svg.text: Detail panels: native lanes · encoder layer shapes · adapter/fusion/control
